test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities was conferred with the National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Aparna Satheesan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dancer Aparna Satheesan, an exponent in Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi, is honoured with the prestigious **National Nritya Shiromani.**** **
 
• **Aparna Satheesan **is also an outstanding representative of the Kuchipudi dance form.
 
• The National Nritya Shiromani award is **given to outstanding dance performers and musicians of India and abroad for promoting and preserving India's traditional classical art forms**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some Famous Dance forms of India:__**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam, Tamil Nadu.
 
• Manipuri Dance, Manipur.
 
• Kathak.
 
• Odissi Dance, Orissa.
 
• Kathakali.
 
• Mohiniattam. 
 
• Kuchipudi.
 
• Sattriya Dance
